label: mudd-900s-nan
description: MUDD real A/B attempt #1 at the locked shape, 900s budget -- diverged to NaN around step ~270-280 (loss climbed 4.7->6+ then oscillated before NaN, while the same optimizer/schedule trains the baseline stably past 900+ steps)
note: Root cause: MuddCompose.w1/w2/bias (real weight matrices, not true scalars) were in the SCALAR_LR=0.20 AdamW group (8x more aggressive than MATRIX_LR=0.025) -- an implementation/hyperparameter bug, not a fundamental flaw in the MUDD mechanism. Fixed by giving them their own AdamW group at MATRIX_LR; see mudd-900s-v2 for the retest.

label: mudd-900s-v2

verdict: REAL NEGATIVE, both dimensions worse than baseline: 646 steps/1.146435 vs 995 steps/1.094327. dt~1.40s/step vs baseline's ~0.90s/step (O(L) dense-connection compute overhead), and worse quality even accounting for fewer steps. Consistent with the paper's own depth-scaling framing: MUDD's demonstrated benefit is at LM depths >=24 layers (up to 42); this repo's locked DEPTH=6 is well below anything the paper tests. Not kept, default OFF.

Also re-validated the transplanted NKI kernels in their new home directly on device: fwd max_rel 1.2e-06 vs the eager scan, bwd worst 4.9e-05 across 3 shapes incl. the competition shape, dispatcher confirmed taking the NKI path bit-exactly and falling back when the toggle is off.
